summary: Anonymous npm package executes obfuscated payload via Function() constructor on require
details: Package x6842179305@1.0.0 ships a single file 1.js declared as main. The file consists of a single Function(...) constructor invocation whose ~683KB body implements a custom PRNG/XOR decoder (using constants 0x9e3779b9, 0x243f6a88, 0x6a09e667) over an inline hex-escaped byte table, then executes the decoded bytes as JavaScript. Requiring or importing the package causes the decoded payload to run in the installer's Node process with the caller's privileges. The payload's behavior, network destinations, and any credential access are hidden behind the decoder and cannot be inspected without executing it. Variable names (LP_BPwm, eRqI67V, F9dFCuu, gmnl98) and the throwaway package name (x6842179305) with no README, metadata, or documented purpose are consistent with a dropper/loader rather than legitimate minification.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
